title: Receiver-Conditioned Clarification for Multi-Agent Food Assistance
abstract: arXiv:2611.23572v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Food insecurity creates a pressing need for guidance that helps households find usable food resources and assess food choices in light of their circumstances. Such guidance must connect eligibility requirements, practical access constraints, and dietary needs rather than return isolated listings or generic nutritional advice. Multi-agent food assistants can coordinate these tasks, with uncertainty indicating when clarification or verification is needed before a recommendation. However, uncertainty can be lost across agent handoffs, allowing tentative interpretations to propagate as facts and obscuring opportunities for correction. Moreover, confidence that a service requirement has been interpreted correctly is not confidence that a recommendation satisfies the user's needs; local confidence cannot simply be reused as downstream reliability. We introduce an inference-time, receiver-conditioned clarification framework that preserves share

translated_title: 面向多智能体食物援助的接收端条件化澄清机制
translated_abstract: 粮食不安全使人们迫切需要一种指导，帮助家庭寻找可用的食物资源，并根据自身情况评估食物选择。这种指导必须将资格要求、实际获取限制和饮食需求相互关联起来，而不是仅仅返回孤立的列表或泛泛的营养建议。多智能体食物助手可以协调这些任务，其中不确定性用于指示在给出建议之前何时需要澄清或验证。然而，不确定性可能在智能体之间的交接过程中丢失，导致暂定性的解释被当作事实传播，并掩盖了纠正的机会。此外，确信某项服务要求已被正确解读，并不等于确信某个建议能够满足用户的需要；局部的置信度不能简单地被复用为下游的可靠性。我们提出了一种推理时的、接收端条件化的澄清框架，该框架能够保留共享的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种推理时的接收端条件化澄清框架，以解决多智能体食物援助系统中不确定性在智能体交接时丢失、以及局部置信度被误当作下游可靠性的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an inference-time, receiver-conditioned clarification framework for multi-agent food assistance that preserves uncertainty across agent handoffs and distinguishes local interpretation confidence from downstream recommendation reliability.
